pages.text: [#](53341a)A small-circle ward that keeps unwanted creatures out. It does not harm them — it repels them, making a brief sacred space that beasts and enemies find hard to cross.[#]()
pages.title: Rite of Sanctity

pages.text: [#](53341a)Offer a **Feather** with **Redstone** on a small circle, with **500 altar power** ready. Do not confuse it with the Rite of Imprisonment, which has the opposite effect.[#]()
pages.title: The Working

pages.text: [#](53341a)Cast it against panic, interruption, or crowding while you prepare a longer working. Not permanent, not a wall, but enough to keep the world at a distance.[#]()
